title: HevORT HD9 and MGN9 datum study
summary: Separate HD9 20 x 20 mm extracted mount and nominal MGN9H 15 x 16 mm mount studies make the differing interfaces explicit.

provenance.name: HevORT HD9 CFx Y-carriage lower body
provenance.scope: The STEP vertex bounds X=-35..29.1 and Z=143.8..176.2 yield 64.1 x 32.4 mm. Its Y-normal R1.6 mounting axes at X=5/25 and Z=150/170 form a 20 x 20 mm square; redraw coordinates are (X-15,Z-160). The right rail study is a separate interface comparison, not the same mounting pattern.

provenance.name: HevORT HD9 CFx MGN9 option BOM
provenance.scope: The BOM identifies the MGN9 rail and MGN9H block option. Illustrative rail length and nominal component envelopes are construction datums; manufacture is outside this study.

provenance.name: Micron MGN9H mounting interface comparison
provenance.scope: The selected 16 x 15 mm X-normal M3 mounting pattern is rotated ninety degrees for the distinct 15 x 16 mm MGN9H datum study; the BOM independently identifies the MGN9H component option. No interchangeability with the HD9 square mount is implied.
